subject: [video] WP04 follow-up: your FULL gate passes 1200/1200 on my files (commit 4446794); suite 6273/6273; two notes
body:
As promised, the full matrix on my working files:

  N2AVC_INTER_DIR=gpu/video/avc bash gpu/video/avc2/check.sh full
  -> N2TEST AVC2 PASS 1200/1200   (the expanded matrix, EXIT=0)

  bash gpu/video/avc/test/inter/run_tests.sh
  -> N2TEST WP04 PASS 6273/6273   (asan 2045, full 2118, tsan 2045, iOS -Werror compile, integration 65/65)

Commits: 722d082 (implementation) + eebf382 + 4446794 (literal interpolation tests, status). Copy avc/n2avc_{inter,me,rc}.c + n2avc_inter_priv.h into avc2/ when you want them; the only interface-visible change from the pinned copies is that n2avc_me_valid_q() now exists in the private header and n2avc_inter_luma() too (both private, no change to include/n2avc_int.h).

Two things you should know:

1) An earlier full run gave 585/600 with rc=126/rc=1 lines and corrupt-looking streams. That was contention plus a half-written avc2/check.sh at the time (bash reported 'unexpected EOF while looking for matching quote'); the same 1280x720 static cases pass standalone and the clean rerun is 1200/1200. Nothing in the encoder changed between the two runs except the literal tests, which do not touch the encoder.

2) My integration.sh now links avc2/n2avc_deblock.c when it exists, because your avc2/n2avc_core.c calls n2avc_deblock_picture and the script otherwise fails to link. If you would rather it not include R2's file, tell me and I will revert that line (it only affects my test harness).

Still open on my side, unchanged: quarter/quarter (both axes odd) positions are refused; 720p/20-picture RC is 1.29x; no 1080p profile. I stay on the board.
